subtitle: AI Memory Supercycle
hook: Micron is the only U.S.-listed pure-play on the AI memory supercycle — a structural DRAM/NAND oligopoly (Micron, SK Hynix, Samsung control 90%+ of DRAM) experiencing the tightest supply/demand imbalance in its history.

subtitle: Custom AI Silicon & Optical Interconnect
hook: Marvell is the #2 player in the custom AI-silicon (XPU/ASIC) duopoly and a leader in AI optical interconnect — the two arms-dealer businesses that capture hyperscaler capex regardless of which GPU or accelerator wins.

subtitle: Bitcoin Miner Turned AI Data Center 'Landlord
hook: Hut 8 is a former Bitcoin miner that has repositioned itself as a 'power-first' energy-infrastructure and AI data center developer — effectively an AI real estate / landlord model.

subtitle: Data Center & Grid Electrical Distribution Equipment
hook: Forgent is one of the purest public plays on the 'grid-to-chip' electrical bottleneck of the AI buildout — a U.S. designer/manufacturer of automatic transfer switches, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, power skids, and prefabricated eHouses that connect utility power to hyperscale data center loads.
